newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rebels kill 51 civilians in Algeria attacks - papers.
newsitem.headline: Rebels kill 51 civilians in Algeria attacks - papers.

text.p: Suspected Moslem rebels killed 51 civilians, including a baby, 12 women and three soccer fans, in four attacks last week in Algiers and the neighbouring province of Medea, Algerian newspapers said on Tuesday.

Rebels in two night-time attacks killed 27 people in one village and 18 in another, the French-language El Watan newspaper said. Three more died in a bomb attack in Medea, and another newspaper reported three other civilians being killed in an ambush in Algiers.
